body: The sun glints off the water, its rays reflecting off the damp planks like tiny gold coins. The wind seems charged with an electric tension, whispering secrets through rustling leaves. My heart races as I realize this could be more than just rainwater—it might be condensation from yesterday’s deluge, pooling on the surface under the relentless gaze of the sun. I take a deep breath, steel my nerves, and start walking towards the edge, ready for whatever comes next.
